title: FKN optimality function
statement: For each natural number $q$, consider inputs $z$ with signs in $\\{−1,1\\}$ and dimension one greater than the FKN optimality tail dimension for $q$. The output is $1$ when the tail of $z$ lies in the small set associated with $q$; otherwise, the output is the first coordinate of $z$.
caveat: The definition of the small set associated with $q$ is not included, so the condition determining the output cannot be made fully self-contained.
